comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: I hope so. Warning for future explorers: this map is definitely in the game, but may have a hidden discovery requirement (or two) before it can be obtained, beyond access to the White Sea permit zone. Neither Japanese nor Taiwan wikis list anything as a pre-req, but at least one player has had difficulties getting this map to generate (as discussed in comments under Ringed seal page).
